free_text: The panel protocol concluded with a decision of no biopsy based on an identical precedent in the labelled series. While the cohort criterion suggested deferral due to the PI-RADS 3 finding and prior negative biopsy, the verifier noted that the critical information regarding the prior biopsy grade was missing. Therefore, the decision remains uncertain until the grade of the prior biopsy is obtained to properly risk-stratify the patient.
